title: `DiagnosticsCPUDetails.__init__` takes 11 positional parameters
detail: Pylint reports 11 positional arguments at line 132, well above the conventional limit of 5. A constructor that accepts 11 individual primitives is hard to call correctly without keyword arguments and is error-prone when argument order changes. Suggested fix: introduce a dataclass or accept a single dict/dataclass holding the CPU detail fields.
